messages:
Rohit Menon: hi all, new hire here. Quick onboarding hiccup: Grafana embeds on the internal playbook show "panel not found" but the dashboard opens fine when i go to grafana directly. anyone know why embeds fail?
Lina (devex): welcome Rohit! :wave: is this the playbook under /playbooks/observability/incident-runbooks? can you paste the iframe link?
Rohit Menon: yep that's the page. embed url: https://grafana.redwood.example/d-solo/uid987/prod-metrics?orgId=1&panelId=12. iframe shows a tiny broken image and "panel not found" text.
Alex (obs-eng): likely the signed embed token expired or the dashboard is in a folder without embed permissions. Also check if your corporate SSO session is fresh; embeds rely on the embed service.
Rohit Menon: i'm on SSO and VPN. Console shows 401 on the render endpoint.
Lina (devex): ok i'll create a ticket to add you to the embed group and ask infra to check token rotation. @DevEx Bot can you open a ticket?
DevEx Bot: Created ticket #DX-3358 - "Embed: add rohit@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-embeders; check grafana render token rotation". Assignee: Lina. ETA: 1 business day.
Alex (obs-eng): temporary workaround: open dashboard direct and use Share > Snapshot or direct link to the panel. For runbook screenshots, use snapshot.
Rohit Menon: got it, thanks. two other small onboarding asks: 1) datadog CLI shows "403 Forbidden" when I try to create an app key; 2) in Sentry I can't see the org projects (only my sandbox). who handles these?
Lina (devex): Datadog app keys require `observability-cli` role or infra approval to create. i'll add the app-key creation to #DX-3358. For Sentry, we typically add new hires to org teams via obs-eng. @Alex can you add Rohit to the frontend and platform projects?
Alex (obs-eng): sure. send me your repo access or project slugs. i'll add you to the Sentry teams and create the datadog app key request.
Rohit Menon: repo is github.com/redwood/platform, projects: platform-infra, platform-api. thanks!
Alex (obs-eng): added note to ticket, will add Sentry access in ~2h and follow up when Datadog app key is approved.
Rohit Menon: sweet, appreciate the quick help. Lina, please post updates to #DX-3358.
Lina (devex): will do. welcome aboard again! :tada:
